name: Post-matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India

rules.quote: meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of minority community
secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination
the annual income of whose parents/guardian from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2 Lakh
The scholarship is to be awarded for studies in India
30% of scholarship would be earmarked for girl students.
Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Jain and Zoroastrians (Parsis) have been notified as minority communities under Section 2 (c) of the National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992.

rules.value: courses under one year and certificate courses not covered
rules.quote: any course of less than one year duration is not covered under this scheme; Certificate courses are also not covered

rules.value: selection weightage to lower income over marks
rules.quote: Inter-se selection weightage is to be given to poverty rather than marks

rules.value: max two students per family across MoMA scholarships
rules.quote: Scholarship will not be given to more than two students from a family (applicable for all Scholarship schemes meant for minorities under this Ministry taken together).

rules.value: only one central scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/minority
rules.quote: A student shall be eligible for only one scholarship out of all the available Scholarships of Central Government meant for SC/ST/OBC/ minority.

rules.value: renewal needs 50% in previous year, same course and institute
rules.quote: The continuance of award (for Renewal applicants) will be subject to securing 50% marks in the previous year’s examination (provided the students pursues the same course and same Institute/School).

amount.text: Admission/tuition fee: Class XI-XII Rs 7,000 pa, technical/vocational XI-XII level Rs 10,000 pa, UG & PG Rs 3,000 pa (subject to actuals); maintenance allowance for 10 months: XI-XII Rs 380/230 pm (hosteller/day scholar), UG-PG non-technical Rs 570/300 pm, MPhil/PhD Rs 1,200/550 pm (2017-20 rates)
amount.quote: Admission and tuition fee for UG & PG level: Rs. 3,000/- per annum subject to actuals (both Hosteller & Day Scholar)

documents.name: Income certificate of parent/guardian
documents.quote: An Income Certificate, issued from a Competent Authority in the State/UT Governments is required in respect of parent/guardian of the student.

documents.name: Self-certified community certificate
documents.quote: A Self-Certified Community Certificate is required from the student who has attained 18 years of age.

documents.name: Aadhaar number
documents.quote: It will be necessary for the eligible applicants to provide Aadhaar number while applying for the scholarship

deadline.text: Apply on NSP; 2026-27 NSP student close 31-10-2026 per registers/nsp_central_2026_27.csv
deadline.quote: It is mandatory for all students to apply online on the website i.e. www.scholarships.gov.in.
